name: ball_proximity_a_ball_rolling_away_from_the_car_is_charged
description: 1v1: blue is parked 310 uu from the ball, which rolls away at 1000 uu/s. 30 steps are 2 s, so the ball ends about 2000 uu further (constant speed: 2300 uu from the car, Phi 0.881 -> 0.260). Hand estimate at constant speed: sum = gamma*Phi_end - Phi_start + (gamma-1)*sum of Phi = -0.666. The engine's ball slows a little on the floor, so it ends closer and the measured sum is -0.583 (band -0.70 .. -0.50). The point: the loss is charged as it happens, as a raw -0.58 for the 4-weighted -2.3 swing.

expect.intent: the proximity lost as the ball leaves
